priorityList: Use Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation, Trinkets, Racial abilities, and Potion.
Use Festering Scythe if its debuff has fallen off.
Use Epidemic when at 80+ Runic Power or on a Sudden Doom proc (at 3+ targets, or 5+ targets during Forbidden Knowledge).
Use Epidemic as a filler (or Death Coil for fewer than 3/5 targets).
Apply and maintain Virulent Plague via Outbreak.
Cast Dark Transformation on cooldown to empower your primary pet.
Cast Apocalypse to summon a Rider of the Apocalypse.
Cast Abomination Limb to group enemies and trigger Pustule Burst procs.
Cast Defile or Death and Decay and remain within the area for Scourge Cleave.
Spend Sudden Doom procs immediately on Epidemic.
Cast Scourge Strike or Clawing Shadows while standing in Defile to hit up to 8 targets.
Cast Epidemic to spend Runic Power and avoid capping.
Cast Festering Strike if the primary target has no Festering Wounds.
